label_zh: 知识图谱、知识库、档案库
purpose: Federated discovery and bounded read-only retrieval across global knowledge graphs, scholarly metadata, public libraries, archives, cultural heritage collections, government data catalogs, research repositories and sector knowledge systems.

coverage_model.reason: No finite static registry can truthfully contain every country, region, industry, archive, library, database and future source. Coverage is achieved by authoritative aggregators, national anchors, open registries and protocol-based discovery, then expanded by allowlisted source onboarding.
coverage_model.web_discovery_rule: Exa and Tavily are discovery/corroboration layers only. They may discover candidate primary sources but must not upgrade an unverified page into authoritative evidence.
coverage_model.mcp_security_rule: Registry discovery does not imply installation or execution. New MCP/API endpoints remain catalog-only until origin, terms, authentication, read/write surface, rate limits and bounded-operation allowlists are reviewed.

protocol_families.policy: fixed official host and path; no arbitrary URL
fixed query templates or explicit query allowlists; no arbitrary update operations
metadata-only, bounded page/resumption-token traversal, provider terms respected
fixed CQL templates generated from bounded user terms

protocol_families.use: cultural heritage manifests and image metadata
protocol_families.policy: metadata/manifests first; binary media not proxied by default
catalog metadata first; dataset payload fetched only by separately approved source adapter
public metadata and explicitly open files only

geographic_resolution_policy.country: Resolve official national library, national archives, national statistics/open-data portal, national research repository network and national legal/publication portal first; then supranational/global aggregators.
geographic_resolution_policy.subnational_region: Resolve province/state/city official open-data and archive/library portals, then local universities/research institutes, then national and global aggregators.
geographic_resolution_policy.cross_border_region: Use supranational portals and harmonized global datasets, preserving each source jurisdiction and provenance.
geographic_resolution_policy.institution: Resolve canonical organization identity through ROR/Wikidata/VIAF where applicable, then locate official repository/API/OAI-PMH/SRU endpoints.
geographic_resolution_policy.language: Preserve source-language title/description and language code; translation is a downstream presentation layer and never overwrites source metadata.

law_policy: legal databases with explicit access rights

record_contract.raw_content_policy: Do not indiscriminately mirror copyrighted full text or binary archives. Store/query metadata and source links by default; retrieve content only when license/access rights and a bounded task require it.

runtime_invariants: no arbitrary SPARQL UPDATE or remote code execution
bounded query terms, pagination and response bytes
provider authentication secrets stay in runtime secret storage, never Git
rate limits and provider terms are authoritative
restricted, licensed, confidential or personal records are metadata-only until explicit authorized access exists
